# Project Guidelines

## Overview

Warframe game data pipeline that pulls data from community APIs, official DE exports, and wiki sources, then transforms and bundles it into AI-readable `.txt` files for the **Oda Fragment** Discord bot (Cephalon assistant powered by Google Gemma 4).

All output is tuned for Gemma 4's smaller context window (~128K tokens) and stricter instruction-following: ASCII-only formatting, explicit `RULE`/`FORMAT`/`FACT`-style markers, square-bracket slot tokens (`[NAME]`, never `«PLACEHOLDER»`), no unicode bullets (`▸`/`•`), and no `>` blockquote item headers. The retrieval layer is expected to inject only the relevant slice of the `.txt` files into the user turn, since Gemma cannot hold all 14 MB at once.

**Four-stage pipeline:**
1. `pull.js` — Fetches raw JSON from APIs and npm packages into `data/`
2. `extract-wiki.py` — Reads HuggingFace wiki parquet dataset → curated `data/wiki-*.json` files
3. `transform.js` — Converts all JSON into structured `.md` files in `docs/` subdirectories
4. `organize-docs.js` — Bundles `.md` files into themed `.txt` files (≤3 MB each) in `docs/`

## Architecture

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `pull.js` | Data fetcher — HTTP calls + npm package reads → `data/*.json` |
| `extract-wiki.py` | Wiki extractor — HuggingFace parquet → `data/wiki-*.json` (10 categories + enrichment) |
| `transform.js` | JSON → Markdown — `data/*.json` → `docs/{equipment,weapons,mods,...}/*.md` |
| `organize-docs.js` | Markdown → Bundles — `docs/**/*.md` → `docs/*.txt` (15 themed files, ≤3 MB) |
| `data/` | Raw JSON (gitignored, regenerated by pull + extract) |
| `docs/*.md` | Intermediate Markdown (~64 files in subdirectories) |
| `docs/*.txt` | Final AI-readable output (15 files, ~14 MB total) — uploaded to Oda Fragment |
| `prompts/` | System prompt and response format templates for the bot |

### Data Sources

**npm packages:**
- `@wfcd/items` — All Warframe items (17k+), CJS require
- `@wfcd/patchlogs` — Patch notes, read from `data/patchlogs.json`
- `@wfcd/relics` — Relic generator (async `.generate()`)
- `warframe-worldstate-data` — Worldstate reference, ESM-only (use dynamic `import()`)
- `warframe-public-export-plus` — DE public export, CJS require
- `warframe-riven-info` — Riven tags, read JSON directly from `node_modules`

**APIs / scraped sources:**
- Drop tables — `https://drops.warframestat.us/data/all.json`
- Overframe.gg community builds — HTML scrape via `pull-overframe.js` (cheerio + `__NEXT_DATA__`). No public API. Listing route exposes only three category slugs: `warframes`, `archwing`, `sentinels` (other slugs silently fall back to warframes — no aggregate weapons/beasts listing exists). ToS risk: throttled at 1500 ms; cache 24 h. Output: `data/overframe-builds.json`. Optional / opt-in — NOT part of `npm run pull`. Add `--enrich` to fetch per-build mod loadouts (slow).

**Wiki (Python):**
- HuggingFace dataset `LLukas22/wf-wiki` — cloned as a git submodule-style repo into `data/wf-wiki/` (parquet shards under `data/wf-wiki/latest/`)
- Refresh with `git -C data/wf-wiki pull` (origin: `https://huggingface.co/datasets/LLukas22/wf-wiki`)
- Parquet schema: filtered to `namespace_id == 0` and `is_redirect == False`; uses the `title` and `wikitext` columns
- Requires `mwparserfromhell`, `pandas`, `pyarrow`
- Outputs 10 category JSONs + `wiki-enrichment.json` (3,100+ item descriptions injected into transforms)

### Output Files

| File | Size | Contents |
|------|------|----------|
| `warframe-data-equipment.txt` | ~463 KB | Warframes, Archwings, Railjack, Companions |
| `warframe-data-weapons.txt` | ~1.3 MB | Primary, Secondary, Melee, Arch-Guns, Arch-Melee |
| `warframe-data-mods.txt` | ~2.3 MB | Mods, Arcanes, Riven tags |
| `warframe-data-items.txt` | ~1.1 MB | Resources, Fish, Gear, Quests, Enemies, Star Chart, Syndicates |
| `warframe-data-drops-missions.txt` | ~569 KB | Mission and bounty reward tables |
| `warframe-data-drops-relics.txt` | ~1.7 MB | Void Relics, mod/blueprint drop locations |
| `warframe-data-drops-enemies.txt` | ~422 KB | Enemy drop tables |
| `warframe-data-export.txt` | ~933 KB | DE public export — Warframes, Weapons, Mods, Recipes, Regions |
| `warframe-data-export-extended.txt` | ~333 KB | Focus Schools, Dojo, Nightwave, Vendors, Syndicates |
| `warframe-data-lore.txt` | ~515 KB | Characters, factions |
| `warframe-data-quests.txt` | ~377 KB | Quest walkthroughs |
| `warframe-data-mechanics.txt` | ~402 KB | Damage types, status effects, game systems |
| `warframe-data-systems.txt` | ~562 KB | Open worlds, endgame, modular equipment |
| `warframe-data-patchnotes.txt` | ~3.0 MB | Full patch history |
| `warframe-data-mastery-rank.txt` | ~3 KB | Mastery rank requirements |
| `warframe-data-community-builds.txt` | varies | Overframe.gg top builds for Warframes / Archwings / Sentinels (only categories Overframe exposes via SSR). Community-curated, T3-equivalent, suggestion-only. Each entry flagged `(community-curated, source: Overframe)`. Mod listings never include polarity or drain. Bot must never let these override authoritative stats. |

### Prompts

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `prompts/oda-fragment.md` | System prompt — identity, core directives, source hierarchy, security. Delivered as the FIRST user turn (Gemma has no system role). |
| `prompts/oda-fragment-response-format.md` | Fragment category-specific response templates with `[SLOT]` tokens (square brackets — Gemma is more reliable than with `«»`). |

## Code Style

- CommonJS (`require`) for all JS — except `warframe-worldstate-data` which requires dynamic `import()`
- Python 3 for `extract-wiki.py` (mwparserfromhell, pandas, pyarrow)
- JSHint for linting (see `.jshintrc`): enforce curly braces, quote consistency, no unused vars
- No TypeScript, no build step, no bundler
- Flat helper functions, no classes or abstractions

## Build and Run

```bash
npm run pull              # Fetch fresh JSON from all APIs and packages
python3 extract-wiki.py   # Extract wiki parquet → data/wiki-*.json
node pull-overframe.js    # OPTIONAL: scrape Overframe.gg community builds (ToS risk; opt-in)
npm run transform         # Convert JSON → docs/**/*.md
node organize-docs.js     # Bundle .md → docs/*.txt (≤3 MB each)
npm run lint              # JSHint
npm run validate          # npm ls (dependency check)
npm run update            # Shortcut: pull + transform (no wiki, overframe, or organize)
```

## Agent Workflow — Always Follow This Order

Whenever you modify data sources, add new content, or update transforms:

1. **Pull** — `npm run pull` to fetch latest raw JSON. Never work with stale data.
2. **Wiki extract** (if wiki-related) — `python3 extract-wiki.py` to regenerate `data/wiki-*.json`.
3. **Inspect** — Read relevant `data/*.json` files to confirm shape and content.
4. **Transform** — `npm run transform` to regenerate all `.md` files.
5. **Organize** — `node organize-docs.js` to regenerate all `.txt` bundles.
6. **Verify** — Read updated `docs/*.txt` files to confirm correctness.
7. **Lint** — `npm run lint` to catch code-style issues.

For prompt-only changes (editing `prompts/`), skip all pipeline steps.
For transform-only changes, skip pull and wiki extract but always re-run steps 4–7.

## Conventions

### Adding a new data source

1. Install the package: `npm i -S <package>`
2. In `pull.js`: add a numbered section that loads and writes JSON to `data/`
3. In `transform.js`: add a `transformXxx()` function, call it from `main()`
4. In `organize-docs.js`: add the new `.md` file(s) to the appropriate group in `mdFiles` array
5. Re-run the full pipeline (steps 1–7 above)

### Markdown output format

- Every `.md` file starts with `# Title` + a 1-2 sentence description paragraph
- Use `##` for each item/entry, `###` for sub-sections (abilities, crafting, etc.)
- Use Markdown tables for stats and drop tables, not raw JSON
- Include names AND descriptions — the AI works best with natural language text
- Escape pipe characters in table cells with `\|`
- Dedup items within each transform loop using a `Set()`
- Call `cleanWiki()` on all wiki-sourced content before writing
- `writeMd()` sanitizes: forum links, image tags, HTML, Lotus paths, literal `\n`, double spaces, excess newlines

### Data shape gotchas

- Mission rewards: some nodes use rotation letters (`A`/`B`/`C` as arrays), others use numeric keys (flat object)
- Public export names are language keys (`/Lotus/Language/...`) — resolve via `dict_en.json`
- `warframe-worldstate-data` default export has locale sub-objects mixed with data keys; check `wsd.locales` array to distinguish
- Wiki content may contain orphan possessives or comma chains from stripped wikilinks — `cleanWiki()` handles these
- Wiki sections like "Patch History", "Gallery", "Maximization" are noise — `cleanWiki()` strips them
